english.title: Unregistered carrier transport controlled waste in course of business / otherwise with view to profit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) not being a registered carrier of controlled waste, in the course of your business or otherwise with a view to profit, transported controlled waste, namely **(..SPECIFY WASTE..)

(A)_[to]_
(B)_[from]_

a place in Great Britain
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and (5) of the Control of Pollution (Amendment) Act 1989.

welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i'r diffynnydd, nad oedd wedi cofrestru fel cludydd gwastraff a reolir, yn ystod busnes neu fel arall gyda golwg ar wneud elw, gludo gwastraff a reolir, sef **(..SPECIFY WASTE..), i le ym Mhrydain Fawr neu oddi yno
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 1(1) a (5) Deddf Rheoli Llygredd (Diwygio)1989.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit on prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
